description: #222 (c) — m24's world with the cleanup broken: the throwaway detached checkout is created and the baseline passes in it, but `git worktree remove --force` fails. The verdict does not move (removal is best effort and never decides green/red), so the run is still success / completed with outcome pass — and the report says the cleanup did not happen, in BOTH channels: `integration_verify.tree_removed: false` and the `integration_verify_tree_left` limitation, together. Before #222 only the limitation existed, so 'the checkout was removed' and 'this runner is too old to say' were the same report; the pair here is what fixes the true side (m24) as a measurement rather than as an absence. The caller worktree is untouched throughout — a failed cleanup of the runner's OWN checkout says nothing about the caller's index, and both readings stay null.
